pages.text:
One rainy afternoon, <name> was exploring the attic when he found a crumpled note tucked behind an old trunk. Unfolding it, he read a riddle:

"I hide where memories sleep,
Behind doors that creak and leap.
Look for the chest where stories wait,
And there you’ll find what’s truly great."

Excited, <name> grinned. “A secret treasure! Let’s find it!”

He tiptoed past creaky floorboards, careful not to make a sound. He checked the old cupboards, opening each door slowly. In one, a hat fell off a hook, nearly hitting his head! <name> ducked and laughed. “That’s a close one!”

Next, he examined dusty boxes stacked high. He lifted each lid, peeking inside. A stack of old scarves tumbled over, making him giggle. Finally, he noticed an ornate trunk at the far corner, slightly hidden under a blanket of cobwebs. Could this be the place the riddle meant?

<name> knelt down and examined the trunk. It had tiny carvings of stars and moons, just like the ones in the note. He pressed a small button hidden among the carvings, and the lid creaked open to reveal a beautiful family keepsake — an old music box that played a sweet, tinkling tune.

Holding it gently, <name> felt a warm glow. “I found it!” he whispered, smiling. The attic felt magical, filled with memories and soft sunlight through the dusty window.

<name> realized that solving a mystery takes patience, clever thinking, and careful observation. Even the little surprises — creaky floors, falling hats, and dusty boxes — made the adventure exciting.

He carefully closed the trunk, ready to share the music box and the story behind it with his family. That day, <name> learned that curiosity and cleverness turn ordinary places into magical adventures — and that every mystery has its own joyful reward.
